ns2:section.sectionTitle: Ind Study Section S, Sec Event
ns2:section.sectionText: Each student attends fifteen security related events approved by the Director of the Program in Arms Control & Domestic and International Security. Each student takes a lead in organizing and moderating at least one event; or, working alone or in cooperation with another student, leading a discussion on a security related topic. Students completing the requirements for the undergraduate Certificate in Global Security must have credit for either GLBL 199S or NPRE/GLBL 483, Seminar in Security.
